name: 2-in-1 Sandwich Cutter & Sealer | Kids Bread Cutter, Decruster & Uncrustable Sandwich Maker | Random Color
description:
Make fun, neatly sealed sandwiches at home with this 2-in-1 Sandwich Cutter and Sealer. Designed to cut and seal bread in one simple step, it removes the crust and creates a clean, attractive sandwich that is perfect for kids' lunchboxes, school meals, picnics, and family breakfasts. The cutter features a practical combination of stainless steel and PP plastic, providing a durable design that is easy to operate and clean. Its embossed inner sealing edge helps create a neat sealed sandwich, allowing you to add fillings such as chocolate spread, jam, cheese, chicken, tuna, or other ingredients according to your preference.

Key Features
2-in-1 sandwich cutter and sealer design
Cuts bread and seals the edges in one step
Helps remove unwanted bread crusts
Embossed inner edge creates a neat sealed finish
Stainless steel and PP plastic construction
Thickened material helps resist deformation
Smooth cutting edge for convenient use
Detachable parts make cleaning easier
Perfect for making homemade Uncrustable-style sandwiches
Suitable for kids' lunchboxes, school meals, picnics, travel, and home use

Product Specifications
Product Type: Sandwich Cutter & Sealer
Material: Stainless Steel + PP Plastic
Color: Random Color
Function: Cutting, Crust Removal & Edge Sealing
Suitable For: Bread, Sandwiches, Pancakes, Cookies, Fruits & Vegetables
Application: Kitchen, Home, School Lunchbox & Picnic

How to Use
Place one slice of bread on the sandwich cutter
Add your preferred filling such as jam, chocolate spread, cheese, chicken, or tuna
Place another slice of bread over the filling
Open the cutter and position it over the bread
Press down firmly to cut and seal the sandwich
Remove the sealed sandwich and enjoy
Detach the parts and clean after use

Material / Composition
Stainless Steel Cutting Component
PP Plastic Body
Embossed Sealing Edge
Detachable Construction

Safety Information
Handle the cutting edges carefully during use and cleaning
Keep away from small children when not being used under adult supervision
Wash thoroughly before and after use
Do not use damaged or deformed parts
Store in a clean and dry place
